integrity: The all-parameter proof is independent of the numerical example. The bundled verifier checks the displayed ternary example and its MacWilliams coefficients from the published weight enumerator.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns only the dual minimum-distance assertion in Theorem III.1; it does not reassess other statements in the paper. The proof uses the paper's odd-prime hypothesis.
title: The augmented \(D_1\) code in Theorem III.1 is projective: dual distance \(3\), not \(2\)
